summary: Apollo Infrastructure Co LLC filed an 8-K covering two routine items: a private placement of ~1.73M shares of multiple series to accredited/non-US investors for ~$49.3M, exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D/S, and a standard quarterly NAV determination with an announced quarterly share repurchase program (up to 5% of aggregate NAV per quarter) at NAV-based prices. No special-situation event such as a tender offer, going-private, liquidation, or strategic review is present. The filing is a periodic disclosure of ongoing operations.
